CERTIFICATE OF ASSISTANT SECRETARY

The undersigned, being the Assistant Secretary of FDS Holdings, Inc., a Delaware Corporation (the "Company"), does hereby certify as follows:

A) John Rubinetti is an authorized signatory of the Company. B) John Rubinetti has the authority to negotiate and execute contracts on behalf of the Company.

Dated:

FDS HOLDINGS, INC.

or stinifer Tegula Assistant Secretary

I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant.

This instument was acknowledged before me on 12/2/202d Jennifer Tegels seusa a muses Notary Public

HOTRAY RILLEY PUHI
